scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ui,docs" --prefix-colors "magenta.bold,green.bold" "cd packages/csc-ui && pnpm docs:manifest && pnpm build:watch" "cd packages/csc-ui-documentation && pnpm dev"
scripts.release: pnpm --filter @cscfi/csc-ui build && pnpm --filter @cscfi/csc-ui-react build && changeset publish
scripts.test:update: pnpm --filter @cscfi/csc-ui run style-dictionary:build && vitest run --project browser --project examples --update
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:oxlint && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run lint:guards
scripts.lint:guards: pnpm --filter @cscfi/csc-ui run lint:guards && pnpm --filter @cscfi/csc-ui-documentation run lint:examples
